category_summary:
## Hermes Ecosystem Pulse 📰

**Development & Plugin Growth**
The core focus remains on expanding the **Hermes Desktop** ecosystem. The highest-impact update is the preview of a [**Meshy plugin**](/?date=2026-10-21&category=social#item-92e54eb52fd7) by **Teknium**, which offers full **MCP** and **Skill** support, integrating rendered 3D models directly into the chat interface. A crucial enhancement to this plugin is the new capability to [select and download various **3D model file types**](/?date=2026-10-21&category=social#item-51624a673c3d) directly from the in-line chat. Looking ahead, **Teknium** confirmed that [**Tripo (3D generation)** integration](/?date=2026-10-21&category=social#item-8e211a3b5da5) is currently in progress.

**Agent Autonomy & Community Building**
The community showcases are booming. **rlaope** presented [**deepseekbot**](/?date=2026-10-21&category=social#item-d6a638fac902), a powerful personal agent utilizing **DeepSeek (DSH)**, combining complex memory features and a messenger gateway. Furthermore, **Teknium** made an impressive claim regarding [**Hermes** autonomy](/?date=2026-10-21&category=social#item-6f60b010e65d), revealing that an action previously attributed to him was actually performed entirely by the agent on its own computer. This signals a major step in the agent's ability to operate independently.

**Performance & Roadmap Signals**
*   **Oh-My-Hermes** Milestones: **rlaope** provided [detailed community adoption case studies for **Oh My Hermes**](/?date=2026-10-21&category=social#item-4e6039cd828e), highlighting exceptional performance gains, including roughly **4x cost savings**, **6x speed**, and **2x memory** efficiency, along with a [milestone announcement of **3.5k stars**](/?date=2026-10-21&category=social#item-99cb431729dd) for the tool.
*   **Future Platforms**: **Teknium** confirmed a highly requested item: a [**Hermes mobile app**](/?date=2026-10-21&category=social#item-7d0935d3fa0c) is currently in development, adding crucial weight to the product's roadmap.
*   **Ecosystem Depth**: **NousResearch** further expanded its feature map, detailing its [generative media ecosystem](/?date=2026-10-21&category=social#item-b39b5e6ab326), including access to **Krea/Fal** via the **Nous Portal tool gateway** and support for **Blender** plugins.
